name: Infantry_Notes
author: Infantry AI
description: The project knowledge notes: memory notes (project, role, session, global), the append-only decisions log and the issues log.

config.title: Notes
config.applies: Applies to: who may write or delete global notes (shared by every project on this install).

fields.label: Roles that may write global notes
fields.description: Comma-separated role ids. The owner (no session) may always write. Every agent may read.

tools.name: infantry_memory
tools.description: Read and write knowledge notes (what `infantry memory show|search|index|save|delete` does). action=show needs name; action=search needs query (matches names, descriptions and bodies); action=index lists notes; action=write needs name, description, body (replaces the note; optional folder); action=update needs name and content (appends; with find it replaces that one exact passage); action=delete needs name. scope: project (default), global (shared by every project on this install; writing needs a role in setting knowledge.globalWriteRoles, default pm), role (your role's notes), session; show without scope tries role, then project (which includes global), then session.

body.description: action=write: the note body (replaces the note).

content.description: action=update: text to append (or the replacement for find).

find.description: action=update: the one exact passage to replace.
